description: Main activity class for an Android searchable dictionary app, handling search queries, displaying results, and managing search suggestions.

classes.name: SearchableDictionary
classes.description: Main activity for the searchable dictionary app, managing search input, displaying results, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and handles the incoming intent.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents when activity is launched in singleTop mode, passing them to handleIntent.

methods.name: handleIntent
methods.description: Processes the intent to determine if it's a search or a suggestion click, and acts accordingly.

methods.name: showResults
methods.description: Queries the dictionary provider with the search term and displays results or no-results message.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and sets up the SearchView if Android version supports it.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, triggering search requests.
